source.name: Enforceable tier (hand-authored)
source.note: Not automatable by design. Credit freezes are identity-verified and interactive; the app's job is to sequence, instruct, and track them, not to pretend it can file them.

entries.name: Equifax security freeze
entries.removes: Blocks new creditors from pulling your Equifax file — the main lever against identity theft using your home address.
steps: Freeze online — you will be identity-verified, so this cannot be automated
Record the freeze PIN; the app stores it in the device vault
Thaw temporarily (free) before applying for credit

entries.name: Experian security freeze
entries.removes: Blocks new creditors from pulling your Experian file.
steps: Record the PIN in the device vault

entries.name: TransUnion security freeze
entries.removes: Blocks new creditors from pulling your TransUnion file.
steps: Record the PIN in the device vault

entries.name: Innovis security freeze
entries.removes: The fourth nationwide consumer reporting agency — most people forget it, which is exactly why freezes there are worth doing.

entries.name: ChexSystems security freeze
entries.removes: Blocks fraudulent bank-account opening in your name — the gap left by the three big bureaus.

entries.name: NCTUE security freeze
entries.removes: Blocks fraudulent phone/utility account opening. Obscure, cheap to do, rarely done.

entries.name: Prescreened credit & insurance offers
entries.removes: Stops the pre-approved credit-card and insurance offer flow at the source — this is the highest-volume removal available to you and it is a statutory right.
steps: For permanent removal, print the form, sign it, and mail it — the mail-back is the only permanent path
Note: it must be redone if you ever opt back in

entries.name: DMAchoice (direct-mail marketing)
entries.removes: Cuts addressed junk mail. Weak and slow; included only because it is cheap.
steps: Check the current fee at the site before paying anything — this has changed before

entries.name: Digital Advertising Alliance opt-out
entries.removes: Sets opt-out cookies for participating ad networks — per-browser only, wiped by clearing cookies. Low durability, low effort.
steps: Opt out in each browser you actually use

entries.name: NAI network advertising opt-out
entries.removes: Same idea as DAA, different membership list.

entries.name: Have I Been Pwned notifications
entries.removes: Nothing. Tells you when an address appears in a new breach. Included so the ledger can distinguish 'removed' from 'leaked again', which are different problems.
steps: Treat a notification as a credential-rotation task, not a removal task
